title: Patient Mood Trends with RANGE Interval Frame
prompt: A mental health platform (modeled on CDC BRFSS mental health tracking) maintains a `mood_logs` table. Each row is a patient's daily mood rating with a `log_date` (stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'), a self-reported `mood_score` (1-10 integer, stored as TEXT), a `patient_id` (state abbreviation format, two uppercase letters), a `session_type` (TEXT array of session tags), and a `notes` column (raw text with leading/trailing whitespace). You need to compute, for each log, a 7-day trailing average mood score: the average of all mood scores logged by the same patient on dates from 7 days before the current log_date UP TO AND INCLUDING the current log_date. Rows with the same log_date must share the same 7-day window (peer rows). Return: `patient_id`, `log_date`, `cleaned_notes` (trimmed, lowercase), `first_tag` (the first element of the session_type array), `log_month` (two-digit numeric month extracted from log_date), `mood_score` (as INTEGER), and `trailing_7day_avg` (rounded to 1 decimal). Filter to rows where the session_type array contains 'cbt'. Order by patient_id, log_date.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE mood_logs (patient_id TEXT, log_date TEXT, mood_score TEXT, session_type TEXT[], notes TEXT);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO mood_logs (patient_id, log_date, mood_score, session_type, notes) VALUES ('CA', '2024-06-01', '7', ARRAY['cbt', 'journaling'], '  First session  '), ('CA', '2024-06-03', '6', ARRAY['cbt'], ' Follow-up '), ('CA', '2024-06-08', '8', ARRAY['cbt', 'mindfulness'], 'PROGRESS NOTED'), ('CA', '2024-06-09', '8', ARRAY['cbt'], '  Same '), ('NY', '2024-06-05', '5', ARRAY['cbt'], ' Initial '), ('NY', '2024-06-10', '7', ARRAY['emdr'], 'Different'), ('NY', '2024-06-12', '9', ARRAY['cbt'], '  better  ');

composite_moves: cast mood_score TEXT to INTEGER, handle empty string as NULL
filter to rows where 'cbt' is in session_type array
extract first element of session_type array
EXTRACT month from log_date as two-digit text
window function AVG(mood_score) OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY log_date::DATE RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

hints: You need a trailing date-based window that includes all rows in the same partition whose log_date is within 7 days before (or on) the current row's date. Rows with the same date should see the same frame.
Use a RANGE frame instead of ROWS, keyed on the ORDER BY date value. The frame clause should specify an INTERVAL of 6 days PRECEDING (to get 7 days total including CURRENT ROW).

The exact frame clause is: RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW. Don't forget to cast log_date to DATE in the ORDER BY and also cast mood_score to INTEGER. Filter using 'cbt' = ANY(session_type). Extract the month with TO_CHAR(log_date::DATE, 'MM').
answer_key:
WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    log_date,
    LOWER(TRIM(notes)) AS cleaned_notes,
    session_type[1] AS first_tag,
    TO_CHAR(log_date::DATE, 'MM') AS log_month,
    CASE WHEN mood_score = '' THEN NULL ELSE mood_score::INTEGER END AS mood_score
  FROM mood_logs
  WHERE 'cbt' = ANY(session_type)
)
SELECT
  patient_id,
  log_date,
  cleaned_notes,
  first_tag,
  log_month,
  mood_score,
  ROUND(
    AVG(mood_score) OVER (
      PARTITION BY patient_id
      ORDER BY log_date::DATE
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ),
    1
  ) AS trailing_7day_avg
FROM cleaned
WHERE mood_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY patient_id, log_date;

_meta.scenario: a mental health app tracking session completion and journal entries
